cases.desc: Verify Home screen shows illustration, headline, six tiles and Login button.
cases.expected: Illustration, 3-line headline, six tiles (3 + 3) and one Login button are shown on blue background; no Register Now, chatbot or accessibility icon.
cases.approach: unit-testable - render screen, assert root view backgroundColor equals page token alongside existing content assertions

cases.desc: Verify tile labels and order.
cases.expected: Order is Pay Now, Our Products, Track Application, FAQs, Offers, Contact Us with exact label capitalisation.
cases.approach: unit-testable - tile labels asserted by toEqual with exact capitalisation and order, in label file and as rendered

cases.desc: Verify Home screen loads without waiting for background calls.
cases.expected: Home is drawn and tappable immediately; no blocking loader.
cases.approach: unit-testable - token and version never resolve; no loading overlay and a tile press still navigates

cases.desc: Verify Pay Now action opens the payment portal.
cases.expected: WebView opens the configured payment portal URL with title Pay Now.
cases.approach: unit-testable - divergent: case expects WebView with portal URL, spec decision is Pay Now screen with header and back button only

cases.desc: Verify Our Products action routes to Products.
cases.expected: Products screen opens.
cases.approach: unit-testable - ourProducts tile calls navigate('Products')

cases.desc: Verify Track Application action routes to its destination.
cases.expected: User is taken to the Track Application destination (destination pending confirmation, BRD O-03).
cases.approach: unit-testable - trackApplication tile hands off to TrackApplication route

cases.desc: Verify FAQs action opens FAQ screen.
cases.expected: FAQ screen opens with the FAQ list.
cases.approach: unit-testable - FAQs tile navigates to Faq with fetched list stored

cases.desc: Verify Offers action routes to non-logged Offers.
cases.expected: Offers (non-logged) screen opens.
cases.approach: unit-testable - offers tile navigates to Offers route

cases.desc: Verify Contact Us action opens the Customer Care popup.
cases.expected: Popup "We are here to help!" opens over Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - Contact Us shows the popup on Home with no route change

cases.desc: Verify Login button routes to Login screen.
cases.expected: Login screen opens.
cases.approach: unit-testable - Login press navigates to LoginScreen

cases.desc: Verify FAQ action fetches content when cache is not available.
cases.expected: Spinner shows, FAQ API is called and FAQ screen opens with response data.
cases.approach: unit-testable - empty cache: spinner, one fetch, items stored, Faq opens

cases.desc: Verify FAQ action uses cached content when available.
cases.expected: FAQ screen opens immediately from cache with no new API call.
cases.approach: unit-testable - seeded cache: Faq opens, no fetch, no spinner

cases.desc: Verify user returns to Home after closing the Pay Now WebView.
cases.expected: User returns to Home safely.
cases.approach: unit-testable - divergent: case refers to Pay Now WebView, spec has no WebView; replacement is back button returning to Home

cases.desc: Verify FAQ API failure with no cache shows error.
cases.expected: Spinner closes and error dialog shows: Your request could not be processed at this moment. Request you to try again after sometime. User stays on Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - FAQ fetch rejects with no cache: spinner closes, exact error text rendered, navigate not called

cases.desc: Verify Pay Now URL unavailable is handled.
cases.expected: No crash; WebView error or fallback is shown and user can return to Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - divergent: spec says no WebView and Pay Now is header plus back only, so no URL can be missing

cases.desc: Verify stale session flags are reset on Home entry.
cases.expected: Non-logged route flags are reset and Home behaves as a fresh visitor.
cases.approach: unit-testable - mounting Home with dirty offers form, selected offer and register flag resets all three

cases.desc: Verify Home works when non-logged token generation succeeds.
cases.expected: All quick actions remain accessible.
cases.approach: unit-testable - after token resolves and settles every tile and Login still works

cases.desc: Verify token generation failure is handled silently.
cases.expected: No error shown; Home stays stable and usable (BRD NLH-E01). A later FAQ call may show its own error dialog.
cases.approach: unit-testable - token failure resolves silently, no token stored, no dialog, Home stays usable

cases.desc: Verify no dialog when app version is up to date.
cases.expected: No dialog; Home usable.
cases.approach: unit-testable - equal versions classify as none and none renders no dialog

cases.desc: Verify maintenance dialog is shown.
cases.expected: Blocking dialog shows the server message with Exit button (Android); cannot be dismissed.
cases.approach: unit-testable - maintenance outcome carries server message; dialog shows it with only Exit on Android and is not dismissible; hook marks it blocking

cases.desc: Verify mandatory update dialog.
cases.expected: Blocking dialog "Update your app to experience all the latest features." with Update and Exit; cannot be dismissed.
cases.approach: unit-testable - mandatory outcome renders exact message with Update and Exit on Android, not dismissible

cases.desc: Verify Update button opens the store link.
cases.expected: Play Store (Android) or App Store (iOS) opens target_url.
cases.approach: unit-testable - Update calls onUpdate(targetUrl) and the hook opens target url via Linking; real store opening is device behaviour

cases.desc: Verify optional update dialog can be dismissed.
cases.expected: Dismissable dialog shows; Home usable after dismiss.
cases.approach: unit-testable - optional dialog shows Update and Skip, Skip dismisses, outcome returns to none

cases.desc: Verify update is not enforced when status is not Active.
cases.expected: No dialog is shown.
cases.approach: unit-testable - outdated version with non-Active status classifies as none

cases.desc: Verify version 1.8.10 is treated newer than 1.8.9.
cases.expected: Mandatory update dialog is shown (numeric part-by-part compare).
cases.approach: unit-testable - numeric part-by-part compare; installed 1.8.9 vs 1.8.10 gives mandatory

cases.desc: Verify 401 from version service shows message and logs out.
cases.expected: Server message shows with Okay; on Okay the logout call runs.
cases.approach: unit-testable - divergent: QA expects 401 popup with Okay then logout; spec says no popup and silent logged-in-token clear

cases.desc: Verify version call failure or empty body fails open.
cases.expected: No dialog; Home usable.
cases.approach: unit-testable - failed request or null/empty/malformed body resolves to none; rejected call leaves hook outcome none

cases.desc: Verify version request sends capitalised platform value.
cases.expected: user_agent is exactly Android or iOS (capitalised) and version is the installed version.
cases.approach: unit-testable - request body is exactly {version:'1.8.9', user_agent:'Android'} on Android and 'iOS' on iOS

cases.desc: Verify iOS has no Exit button on blocking dialogs.
cases.expected: Only Update is available; no Exit; dialog cannot be dismissed.
cases.approach: unit-testable - iOS mandatory dialog shows only Update, no Exit, not dismissible

cases.desc: Verify blocking dialog cannot be dismissed by Android back.
cases.expected: Dialog stays open; app is not exited and Home is not reachable.
cases.approach: unit-testable - with a blocking outcome open, hardware back is swallowed: dialog visible, no exit-confirm dialog, exitApp not called

cases.desc: Verify exit confirmation shows on Android back.
cases.expected: Dialog "Are you sure you want to exit!" with CANCEL and Okay shows.
cases.approach: unit-testable - Android back handler shows the dialog; text and CANCEL/Okay buttons asserted

cases.desc: Verify Okay on exit dialog closes the app.
cases.expected: App exits.
cases.approach: unit-testable - Okay calls BackHandler.exitApp once (mocked); real process exit is native

cases.desc: Verify CANCEL on exit dialog keeps user on Home.
cases.expected: Dialog closes; user stays on Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - CANCEL closes the dialog, no exit; hook never navigates

cases.desc: Verify back closes Contact Us popup before exit dialog.
cases.expected: First back closes popup only; second back shows exit dialog.
cases.approach: unit-testable - first back closes popup only, second back shows exit dialog

cases.desc: Verify FAQ back returns to Home.
cases.expected: Home screen is shown.
cases.approach: unit-testable - back from the Faq route pops to NonLoggedInHome and Home is visible

cases.desc: Verify offers form data is cleared on return to Home.
cases.expected: Offers fields are empty.
cases.scenario: State reset when Home regains focus
cases.approach: unit-testable - focus on Home resets the offers form to empty

cases.desc: Verify selected pre-approved offer is cleared on return to Home.
cases.expected: Selected offer is cleared.
cases.scenario: State reset when Home regains focus
cases.approach: unit-testable - focus on Home clears offers.selectedOffer

cases.desc: Verify register return flag is cleared on return to Home.
cases.expected: Register CIF field is not pre-filled or locked from the stale origin.
cases.scenario: State reset when Home regains focus
cases.approach: unit-testable - register return flag cleared on focus; partial - Register CIF field behaviour lives in the Register module, not in this repo

cases.desc: Verify Offers fail screen Ok returns to Home with reset state.
cases.expected: Home shows and offers state is reset.
cases.scenario: State reset when Home regains focus
cases.approach: unit-testable - reset runs on every focus event including return from Offers fail screen; partial - Offers failure screen "Ok" navigation lives in the Offers module, not in this repo

cases.desc: Verify focus reset does not clear FAQ cache or token.
cases.expected: FAQ opens from cache; token still used on requests.
cases.scenario: State reset when Home regains focus
cases.approach: unit-testable - reset keeps faq.items and token; cache opens FAQ without request (separate tests)

cases.desc: Verify popup heading and three rows.
cases.expected: Heading We are here to help!; rows Call Us 022-45297300, Email Us bhflwecare@bajajhousing.co.in, Find Us Branch locator.
cases.approach: unit-testable - popup renders heading and three rows with titles and subtitles

cases.desc: Verify popup closes with its close control.
cases.expected: Popup closes and Home is shown.
cases.approach: unit-testable - close control closes popup with no route change

cases.desc: Verify focus returns to Contact Us tile after closing popup.
cases.expected: Focus returns to the Contact Us tile.
cases.approach: unit-testable - setAccessibilityFocus called with tile handle on close; partial - real TalkBack/VoiceOver focus placement needs a device

cases.desc: Verify popup scrolls at large text sizes.
cases.expected: Popup height is capped, content scrolls inside, nothing clipped.
cases.approach: unit-testable - height cap function and scroll container exist; partial - visual no-clipping at 2x text needs a device

cases.desc: Verify Call, Email and Find Us tap behaviour.
cases.expected: Dialer, mail app and branch locator open as confirmed (BRD O-06, behaviour pending).
cases.approach: unit-testable - tel:, mailto: and BranchLocator navigation per recorded decision; Linking mocked

cases.desc: Verify popup opens only once on rapid taps.
cases.expected: Only one popup instance opens.
cases.approach: unit-testable - two rapid Contact Us taps render exactly one popup

cases.desc: Verify Bearer token is sent on FAQ request.
cases.expected: Authorization: Bearer token plus app-version, platform and device-details headers are present.
cases.approach: unit-testable - FAQ request carries Bearer plus app-version, platform, device-details; no X-BHFL-Auth

cases.desc: Verify token request times out after 10 seconds.
cases.expected: Request aborts at 10 s with no UI error; Home usable.
cases.approach: unit-testable - request configured with 10000 ms timeout, error swallowed, Home usable; real abort is axios behaviour

cases.desc: Verify early FAQ tap waits for in-flight token.
cases.expected: FAQ request waits for the token and succeeds without 401.
cases.approach: unit-testable - token getter waits for in-flight request and client waits for provider (separate tests)

cases.desc: Verify relaunch after 15 minutes uses a fresh non-logged token.
cases.expected: New non-logged token is generated; stale logged-in token is not used.
cases.approach: unit-testable - non-logged slot only and fresh request on start; 15-minute real-time relaunch not modelled

cases.desc: Verify FAQ shows error after token failure.
cases.expected: FAQ request fails and error dialog shows.
cases.approach: unit-testable - failed fetch shows error dialog; token-failure precondition not linked

cases.desc: Verify token request body fields are encrypted.
cases.expected: username and password are encrypted, not plain text; no credentials in release logs.
cases.approach: unit-testable - username and password encrypted in request body; release log check is a build-level check

cases.desc: Verify token is stored after success.
cases.expected: Token held in memory and in encrypted storage key auth_token_Nonlogged.
cases.approach: unit-testable - memory slot and key name asserted; real store encryption not asserted

cases.desc: Verify empty FAQ list keeps user on Home with no dialog.
cases.expected: Spinner closes; user stays on Home; no dialog.
cases.approach: unit-testable - useFaqFlow with fetchFaq resolving [] asserts spinner cleared, no navigate, no error dialog; service returns [] for empty array

cases.desc: Verify non-array FAQ response does not crash.
cases.expected: Treated as empty; no crash; stays on Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - faqService maps non-array bodies to [] without throwing; hook test proves an empty list stays on Home (two links proven in separate tests)

cases.desc: Verify double tap on FAQs sends one request.
cases.expected: Only one FAQ request is made.
cases.approach: unit-testable - three onFaqPress calls with a pending fetch call fetchFaq once

cases.desc: Verify spinner blocks other touches while FAQ loads.
cases.expected: Touches are blocked until the spinner closes.
cases.approach: unit-testable - overlay is a visible modal element while loading and gone afterwards; partial - native touch blocking by the modal needs a device

cases.desc: Verify retry after FAQ failure succeeds.
cases.expected: FAQ screen opens on second attempt.
cases.approach: unit-testable - first fetch rejects, Okay, second fetch resolves; navigate('Faq') and two fetches

cases.desc: Verify Okay on FAQ error dialog keeps user on Home.
cases.expected: Dialog closes; user remains on Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - after failure and Okay: dialog gone, navigate not called, Home still rendered

cases.desc: Verify spinner always clears on FAQ failure or timeout.
cases.expected: Spinner clears and error dialog shows.
cases.approach: unit-testable - FAQ call rejecting with a timeout error clears the spinner and shows the dialog

cases.desc: Verify Home renders with no network.
cases.expected: Home renders fully; only API-backed actions degrade.
cases.approach: unit-testable - all services rejecting leaves Home fully rendered and local tiles working; only FAQs degrades

cases.desc: Verify FAQs with no network shows error.
cases.expected: Error dialog shows; spinner clears.
cases.approach: unit-testable - fetchFaq rejecting: spinner cleared, error dialog visible, no navigation

cases.desc: Verify Pay Now with no network shows WebView error.
cases.expected: WebView error state shows; user can go back to Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - divergent: expects WebView error state; spec has no WebView, Pay Now is header plus back only

cases.desc: Verify network lost mid FAQ fetch.
cases.expected: Request fails; spinner clears; error dialog shows.
cases.approach: unit-testable - request pending then rejects: spinner true, then false with dialog

cases.desc: Verify rapid taps on different tiles open one destination.
cases.expected: Only one destination opens; no duplicate stack entries.
cases.approach: unit-testable - rapid navigations to different destinations produce exactly one navigate call

cases.desc: Verify rapid taps on the same tile do not duplicate screens.
cases.expected: Offers opens once; back returns to Home in one step.
cases.approach: unit-testable - guarded navigate fires once per burst; stack depth needs a real navigator

cases.desc: Verify layout on small screen 320 x 568.
cases.expected: Content scrolls; Login reachable; nothing clipped.
cases.approach: unit-testable - at 320x568 content is inside a ScrollView with Login within it; partial - visual no-clipping on a real 320 x 568 device needs a human

cases.desc: Verify layout on tablet or wide screen.
cases.expected: Content is centred and tiles are not stretched (BRD O-13 pending).
cases.approach: unit-testable - at a wide window the column is capped at layout.columnMaxWidth and centred; tablet rules pending O-13

cases.desc: Verify cold start time to interactive.
cases.expected: Within the agreed target (BRD PERF-1, pending).
cases.approach: manual - cold-start timing on a mid-range device from splash end (PERF-1, 2 s)

cases.desc: Verify no memory growth when opening and closing tiles repeatedly.
cases.expected: Memory stays stable; no crash.
cases.approach: manual - 50 open/close cycles with a memory profiler on device (PERF-5)

cases.desc: Verify Android and iOS parity.
cases.expected: Same layout and flows, except hardware back and Exit button (Android only).
cases.approach: manual - side-by-side layout and flow check on Android and iOS devices
